title: Kedarnath ka Shivling trikoniya kyu hai?
hooks: Kedarnath ka Shivling baki mandiron jaisa gol kyu nahi, balki trikoniya hai?
Mahabharat ke baad Shiv ji ne Bhim se bachne ke liye kaunsa roop liya tha?
Kedarnath mandir ke trikone shivling ka sach kya hai?
hook_why: Points directly to the visible physical anomaly of the Kedarnath lingam that visitors observe, sparking immediate curiosity about its origin.
metaphor: The divine bull sinking into the earth, leaving behind its triangular hump as the eternal anchor of forgiveness.

caption:
Kedarnath ka Shivling aam shivling jaisa gol kyu nahi, balki trikoniya hai? 🏔️🙏
Mahabharat yuddh ke baad Pandavon aur Mahadev ke beech ki yeh romanchak katha Shiva Puran aur Skanda Puran (Kedar Khanda) mein milti hai.
Kya sacha pashchatap sabhi galtiyon ko maaf kar deta hai? Apni raye comment mein zaroor batayein.

claims.claim: The natural rock lingam at Kedarnath is triangular in shape, representing the hump of a bull.
claims.basis: Shiva Purana, Koti Rudra Samhita, and Skanda Purana (Kedar Khanda) explicitly describe the Kedarnath swayambhu rock as the hump (prishtha bhaga) of Shiva's bull form.

claims.claim: Pandavas sought Shiva to atone for the deaths of their kin in the Kurukshetra war.
claims.basis: Mahabharata (Svargarohanika Parva context) and Kedar Khanda describe the Pandavas journey to Garhwal Himalayas for penance.

claims.claim: Shiva took the form of a bull, and Bhima stood astride two rocks to identify him among the herd.
claims.basis: Traditional Sthala Purana of Panch Kedar and Skanda Purana Kedar Khanda narrate Bhima's method of identifying the divine bull.
